title: Distinct Values in a Range
prompt:
**Bài toán.** An array of n integers (values up to 10^6), q queries
`l r`: print the number of distinct values in a[l..r].

**Constraints:** 1 ≤ n, q ≤ 50 000. Offline sweep by right end + Fenwick:
O((n + q) log n).

tests.name: mixed array
all equal
n=50000 full-range queries
tests.hint: 500 distinct values cycling; every full-range answer is 500. A per-query scan is 2.5·10^9 ops — timeout.
